the-shell-manages-apps-as-cards.next: Implement continuous app/card motion, verify the actual shell overlay, then reduce measured card tracking cost and repeat board acceptance.
the-shell-manages-apps-as-cards.rationale: Touch-first drawer and top-shade routes now have cross-build and headless Wayland pixel/input proof. Continuous app/card motion, installed integration, frame budgets and physical acceptance remain open.

the-system-enables-proven-c908-extension.next: Run the remaining exact-image RVV/QEMU and reserved-board checks; keep the normal image unchanged until evidence passes.
the-system-enables-proven-c908-extension.rationale: The committed source and build evidence covers the first five tasks, while later target and physical gates remain unchecked.

the-handheld-presents-a-coherent-shell.next: Evaluate the Rust software-rendered shell client alongside the Qt Quick probe; integrate themed drawer, Settings and notifications with live cards, then verify the image on the board.
the-handheld-presents-a-coherent-shell.rationale: The final UI targets Rust. The C drawer is a host-tested prototype/reference; Settings and notification backends and live-deck overlay routes are landed source checkpoints. Full surface integration and physical acceptance remain open.

the-shell-loads-omarchy-themes.next: Finish full generated-token and client, icon and background integration; check service compatibility, then verify theme selection and persistence on the board.
the-shell-loads-omarchy-themes.rationale: Pinned unchanged-source helpers, native appearance tokens, acknowledged selection and persistent defaults have host/build checkpoints. Explicit background choice is implemented; actual all-surface consumers, wallpaper decoding/playback and physical selection remain open.

the-shell-trials-vglite-composition.next: Resolve target format and presentation costs, then repeat paired GPU-versus-Pixman acceptance on the board before any default change.
the-shell-trials-vglite-composition.rationale: A committed GPU trial exists, but the comparison did not establish a faster accepted default compositor path.
